sentences.en: Russia expresses regret for those lost in the hostage incident.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯对人质事件中的遇难者表示遗憾。

sentences.en: Send in something to eat or I'll kill a hostage.
sentences.zh: 送吃的过来，否则我就杀一个人质。

sentences.en: Our main concern is with the safety of the hostages.
sentences.zh: 我们最关心的是人质的安全。
